title: CivetWeb through 1.16 built with USE_HTTP2 and enable_http2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read… (CVE-2026-135690)
description: CivetWeb versions through 1.16 built with HTTP/2 support enabled contain a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the HTTP/2 header decoding function. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to send a specially crafted HTTP/2 HEADERS frame over TLS to read one byte beyond the allocated heap buffer. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact confidentiality or integrity, only availability to a limited extent.
